production_check.detail: In the full college model (ratings + stats features, each season fit only on earlier seasons) the transfer prior with refit weights changed out-of-sample results: 2024 better (MAE 12.70 vs 12.82, log loss 0.5047 vs 0.5078), 2025 worse (12.69 vs 12.60, 0.4892 vs 0.4871), 2026 weeks 0-5 worse (14.08 vs 13.94, 0.3735 vs 0.3685). The early-season ratings screen passed, but the model people see got worse in the two newest seasons, so production keeps the original prior.
